checks.scope: Adversarial prior-art search beyond the original source family

checks.method: Compared the newly inspected primary theorem statement and author disclosures with the current abstract and Section 7; did not execute the companion or audit the complete proof.
checks.observation: The stronger reported endpoint leaves the present implication and explicit historical comparisons mathematically intact, while requiring a fuller contribution discussion. The new source discloses author-side checks and no independent specialist endorsement or end-to-end formal verification. The revised paper should report the claim and its relevance without certifying it or treating linked artifacts as independent corroborations.

findings.disposition: Acknowledge and compare the reported theorem with accurate verification limits; no claim that 68 is established by this review is requested. Actual retrieval notes are in scratch/literature_reviewer/round07_prior_art68.json and must be frozen as new evidence before closure.
findings.statement: A primary manuscript predating the review cutoff reports the stronger unrestricted endpoint 68 for the same finite simple four-uniform, empty-core-inclusive problem. Its omission makes the present literature map materially incomplete, even though the draft already declines global priority.

required_revisions: Update Section 7 and the references to acknowledge Babanskyy, An upper bound for three-sunflower-free families of four-element sets, aiXiv:2610.01292v1, Theorem 1.1 (https://aixiv.online/html/2610.01292v1), which reports upper bound 68. Explain the present structural/formal contribution relative to pinned A1K despite that stronger reported numerical endpoint. Revise the search-negative sentence to account for this newly inspected primary source; disclose that its full proof and computational suites have not been independently validated here. Add this actual retrieval to a later frozen evidence snapshot.
content.summary: Skeptical searching found a materially relevant prior primary manuscript omitted from the current comparison: Oleksiy Babanskyy, aiXiv:2610.01292v1 (9 October 2026), reports a computer-assisted upper bound 68. This does not contradict the present conditional theorem or its formal contribution, but the literature discussion must acknowledge the stronger reported endpoint and distinguish observation of that claim from independent validation.
